## Description

Please provide a clear and concise description of what this pull request introduces or fixes.

## Motivation & Context

Why is this change required? What problem does it solve?
Fixes # (issue reference if applicable)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Code style / Refactor / Performance improvement
- [ ] 🔒 Security fix

## Testing Checklist

- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass (`npm test`).
- [ ] Added new tests in `test/` for newly added features or bug reproductions.
- [ ] Verified manually on Linux workstation across target browser / terminal emulator.
- [ ] Tested PWA / responsive view on mobile viewport.

## Security & Quality Considerations

- [ ] No hardcoded tokens, secrets, or personal paths.
- [ ] No unescaped user strings passed to shell or terminal execution.
- [ ] No unescaped user strings rendered via `innerHTML`.
- [ ] No restricted brand names or trademarks included.
- [ ] Changes adhere to the motorsport dark-cockpit design system.
